volume.tooltip: Speaker level (−∞…0 dB). 0 dB is unity. Default −3 dB. Old patches that stored 0…1 linear Volume are converted on load. Type a dB value (or −inf).

pan.tooltip: Stereo balance after Mono is summed in. 0 = unchanged (Mono to both). −1 = left only. +1 = right only.

aa.tooltip: Antialiasing. Off is the raw clip. ADAA1 uses the previous sample. ADAA2 uses two previous samples and falls back when the input is flat.

drive.tooltip: Input push into the soft-knee curve.

threshold.tooltip: Amplitude (0...1) where limiting starts. Below this the driven signal is unchanged.

knee.tooltip: How gradual the transition from Threshold toward full scale is. 0 = hard at Threshold.

frequency.tooltip: Sine pitch and noise band centre. Default slider 0…20 kHz. Wired ƒ replaces this knob.

crossfade.tooltip: 0 = pure sine. 1 = full noise. Bandwidth over Crossfade sets how wide the noise band opens.

ampOverCrossfade.tooltip: 0 = constant loudness across the crossfade. 1 = level falls to silence as Crossfade reaches 1 (squared).

bandwidthOverCrossfade.tooltip: How far the noise band opens as Crossfade rises. 0 = stays a tight ring at the pitch. 1 = full Width curve (Q 2000 → 0.5) at Crossfade 1.

pitchModOverCrossfade.tooltip: Color-noise pitch wobble on the sine only (0 = none, 1 = ±2400 cents). The noise band stays on Frequency.

color.tooltip: Noise colour. White / Gaussian / Average / Pink / Brown / Blue / Violet. Level stays flat across the keyboard.

seed.tooltip: Master seed. Reset jack reseeds every noise generator from this value.

frequency.tooltip: AM Index Bias (carrier Hz). f = Speed × (1 + sine × Top Morph).

morph.tooltip: AM Index (normalized). Scales the PolyBLEP sine into Speed. 0 = constant Speed. 1 = Speed × (1 + sine). Spawn 0…1.

sideMorph.tooltip: Adds sine × Side Morph to phase (cycles). 0 = no phase wobble. Breadboard: Sine → attenuverter → Phase.

randomFreq.tooltip: S&H random multiplier on LFO increment (VibratoGenerator randomFreqMult).

randomAmp.tooltip: S&H random multiplier on LFO amplitude (VibratoGenerator randomAmpMult).

delay.tooltip: Delay the incoming Gate going high. Attack starts after this. 0 = Gate-on is immediate. No Gate cable skips to sustain.

endDelay.tooltip: Delay the incoming Gate going low. Release starts after this. 0 = Gate-off is immediate.

attack.tooltip: Depth fade-in after delayed Gate-on. 0 = instant snap. No Gate cable skips Attack and stays at full depth.

release.tooltip: Depth release time after delayed Gate-off. 0 = instant snap.

attackShape.tooltip: Attack curve: Log starts slow and finishes fast; Lin rises linearly; Exp keeps the existing exponential rise. Hidden — enable from the parameter visibility menu.

releaseShape.tooltip: Release curve: Log starts slow and finishes fast; Lin falls linearly; Exp keeps the existing exponential fall.

amplitude.tooltip: Scale and invert. 0 = mute, +1 = unity, −1 = invert. Bipolar rational is finer around 0.

tuning.tooltip: A4 reference Hz. MIDI 69 maps to this frequency when converting Pitch→Hz.

octave.tooltip: Add octaves to the zero-based pitch before Hz conversion.

semitones.tooltip: Add semitones to the zero-based pitch before Hz conversion.

cents.tooltip: Add cents / 100 to the zero-based pitch before Hz conversion.

multiply.tooltip: Hz-domain multiply after Pitch→Hz. Applies to ƒ and inc, not the ♯/♭ thru.

add.tooltip: Hz-domain offset after Multiply. Applies to ƒ and inc, not the ♯/♭ thru.

amplitude.tooltip: Scale and invert. 0 = mute, +1 = unity, −1 = invert. Bipolar rational is finer around 0.

offset.tooltip: Bias. The face edits this. Min, max, reverse, curve, and smooth time are Parameter Settings.

displaySource.tooltip: Mouse = pointer target. Smoothed = Bias after Parameter Settings smooth.
